body: We introduce ABot Embodied Reasoning (ABot-ER), a unified embodied reasoning foundation model that breaks the tension between breadth and depth in embodied reasoning. Embodied intelligence demands the joint mastery of perception, planning, and execution, yet reconciling generality with specialization across this spectrum remains an open challenge. Within a single unified model, ABot-ER commands specialist-level depth across all three competencies, spanning spatial, scene, and temporal reasoning in perception; long-horizon action organization in planning; and point grounding and affordance in execution. The Agentic Data-Model Self-Evolution Engine continuously adapts data strategies to the model's evolving capability state. The Task-Conditioned Adaptive Training Strategy uses task tokens to activate lightweight low-rank residuals over a shared backbone, separating updates from heterogeneous output formats while retaining shared embodied knowledge. Across a systematic evaluation on twelve benchmarks covering three core competencies and five capability dimensions, ABot-ER achieves state-of-the-art overall performance across perception, planning, and execution within a unified parametric framework, demonstrating that breadth and depth can coexist in unified embodied reasoning.
summaryZh: 本文介绍了ABot-ER，一种统一的具身推理基础模型，旨在解决具身智能中广度与深度的矛盾。该模型通过“智能体数据-模型自进化引擎”和“任务条件自适应训练策略”，在感知、规划和执行三个核心维度上实现了专家级性能。在十二项基准测试中，ABot-ER展现了在统一参数框架下同时具备感知、规划与执行能力的优越性，为具身智能的发展提供了新思路。
